response.sql: WITH media_type_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, bytes_per_millisecond, bytes_per_millisecond / AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) OVER () AS relative_to_media_type_average FROM media_type_rates ORDER BY Name;
